parameters.name: BackupDbNames
parameters.description: The name of the database involved in the backup.

parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set.

parameters.name: BackupLevel
parameters.description:
The level of the backup. Valid values:

*   **DB**: The database Level
*   **instance **: instance level

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description: The backup mode. Valid values: **logic** or **phy**.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance for which to modify the backup policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-restore-order --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --preferred-backup-time 2019-09-16_15:12:53 --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names drds_flashback --backup-id 1918df27-4563-11e9-8403-af4fbe000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeRestoreOrder --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --PreferredBackupTime '2019-09-16_15:12:53' --BackupMode phy --BackupLevel db --BackupDbNames drds_flashback --BackupId '1918df27-4563-11e9-8403-af4fbe000000'
